description: Look up earlier approved or human-edited translations of similar source texts (fuzzy, placeholder-aware). For each text, returns up to 3 matches with the stored translation, a match score (100 = exact) and its quality. Use it when translating yourself, to reuse wording the project already uses. source_lang defaults to the project's source language. Takes no branch – the memory is shared across branches.

source_lang.description: The language of `texts`; defaults to the project's source language.

target_lang.description: The language to find translations in.

texts.description: Source texts to look up (sent in chunks of 100).

name: find_translation_memory
title: Find Translation Memory
